kind: synchronous scheduling normalizer factory implementation validation
sourceState: uncommitted, product and test frozen after validation; no commit made
changes: Export an explicit synchronous normalizer factory; keep the old wrapper fresh per call.
Share the factory across local calls in one auditRemainingScopes or recordOutcome invocation.
Every call allocates fresh changes and executes the original mutable-item guards/proof validation; SourceRecord LRU and exact-action key memo are reused.
Events, per-item index refresh order, original sources/conditions/attempts/retry debts and all SDK proof gates stay unchanged.

negativeEvidence: Initial 68 tests passed. Initial typecheck found only missing ActionCandidate fixture fields and Context.value; both fixed. Logs retained.
guards: Fresh factories reread revised actions and unknown receipt status at the same observation ID.
Every call rechecks scope changes, source removal/addition and unknown item outcomes.
Distinct action objects with the same ID but different input values remain distinct.
Ninth source evicts the first of the eight-record LRU; missing source reads stay conservative within a pass and retry in a fresh pass.
Runtime outcome succeeds only through existing exact-source successful receipt verification; no cross-source equivalence is supplied by the test.

cacheBoundary.lifetime: One synchronous audit/outcome only; discard before await, SDK mutation, review/identity revision, or next runtime invocation.
cacheBoundary.transients: An in-progress read/build can hold an additional transient returned value before eviction; caller-held current/snapshot/source and other SDK caches are outside these cache-entry bounds.
cacheBoundary.attempts: The existing per-session attempt map keeps all ledger rows for each session touched in this synchronous pass. It is not capped at eight; memory scales with touched sessions and their ledgers, then is released with the factory.
cacheBoundary.bytes: No constant byte bound: source size and action/attempt count vary. No heap benchmark was run.
cacheBoundary.outerCacheDecision: Retained for minimal scope: preserves current observation preseed and existing raw read behavior. Removing it is not required for correctness or this narrow optimization.

existingEvidenceNotNewPerformance.qualifier: Static 114 calls x 206 candidates, supported by sampled old-source hot stack. Not a measured speedup of the patch.

limitations: No production DB, real browser/provider or network was opened. Test hosts are memory fixtures.
No benchmark or full suite was rerun here. Root owns the fixed-real-input task/events differential and limited performance protocol.
Startup normalization already shares one wrapper-local cache, so this patch does not remove its cost.
Persisted audit bytes and the prior +200975 logical task bytes remain unchanged.
The 114 distinct candidate v2/v3 key pairs still require 228 key computations; the patch removes repeated scope-index construction, not these distinct keys.
Independent ordinary coverage/recovery semantics and unavailable selector boundaries are unchanged.
